description: Quarter-hour ledgers of the capacity-value-curve runs for selected fleet sizes. energy_mwh / discharged_mwh / pnl_eur are per unit battery (1 MW / 2 MWh): multiply by fleet_mw for the fleet; price_eur_mwh is the counterfactual price of the fleet's deviation, base_price_eur_mwh the published price; degradation = 8 EUR/MWh discharged (pnl = energy * price - degradation).
